name: html-editor
title: HtmlEditor
description: A GitHub-style HTML editor with Write/Preview tabs, a tag toolbar, a math/physics/chemistry symbol picker, KaTeX-rendered LaTeX math, keyboard shortcuts, and a fullscreen mode. Preview renders through a sandboxed iframe so scripts never execute.
